question: Which city's police conducted the 48-hour-long Cy-Hawk operation against cybercrimes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Delhi Police conducted the 48-hour-long Cy-Hawk operation to crack down on cybercrimes across the national capital.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Over 1,000 people were arrested or bound down during the 48-hour operation aimed at cyber-related crimes.**
 
• **The crackdown targeted syndicates involved in online fraud, including email fraud, social media crimes, mobile app-related offences, and more.**
 
• **The operation was launched across Delhi and concluded on Friday morning after two days of raids and arrests.**
 
• **The operation highlights the rising concern of cybercrimes in Delhi and across the country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Types of Cybercrimes Targeted**__

 __
 
• Email fraud
 
• Social media crimes
 
• Online transaction fraud
 
• Lottery scams
 
• Net banking/ATM fraud
 
• Business email compromise
 
 
 
• **Operation Details**__
 
 
• Duration: 48 hours
 
• Location: Delhi
 
• Arrests: Over 1,000 individuals
